visual.general_description: Two-panel figure of OCT retinal nerve fiber layer reports for OD and OS: panel A with warm thickness maps and mostly white or green classes, panel B with cooler maps and mostly red classes.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A and panel B are OCT report blocks, each with RNFL thickness maps for OD and OS, a four-quadrant circle and a six-sector ring per eye, and a Diversified Distribution of Normals colour legend. Printed quadrant and sector numbers are listed in the panel descriptions. Panel A circles and rings are white or green; panel B circles and rings are mostly red with the nasal quadrant green in both eyes.

panels.general_description: OCT retinal nerve fiber layer report panel for OD and OS with thickness maps, quadrant circles and six-sector rings.
panels.detailed_description: A white-background OCT report block headed OD at the left and OS at the right, each with an RNFL Thickness Map (colour scale printed from 0 μm to 350, ticks 0, 175 and 350 μm) showing warm colour bands around a central grey disc. Below each map is a four-quadrant circle with printed values: OD S 153, T 68, N 89, I 132 (T and I filled green, S and N white); OS S 188, N 100, T 93, I 159 (all white). Below are six-sector rings with printed values: OD 77, 76, 76, 76, 73, 70, all filled green; OS 79, 82, 80, 82, 80, 80, all filled green. A legend titled Diversified: Distribution of Normals shows white, green, yellow and red bands labelled 95%, 5% and 1%.
